name: fieldnotes-china
description: Plan a China trip, find things to do, and explore local food, sightseeing, culture and shopping through selected Xiaohongshu (XHS / RedNote / Little Red Book) experiences and dated factual sources. Search places, compare options, build an itinerary or save an undated collection, and export a bilingual PDF with Chinese names and addresses. Start with reviewed Shanghai places; Beijing and Chengdu have limited coverage. Check actual city and topic coverage before planning. Shopping means places to visit; gadget recommendations are not available. Searches use indexed evidence and do not start live XHS searches. Independent of Xiaohongshu.

interface.longDescription:
Plan a China trip, find things to do, and explore local food, sightseeing, culture and shopping. This China travel guide and trip planner brings together selected Xiaohongshu (XHS / RedNote / Little Red Book) experiences and dated factual sources, with English context and exact Chinese place names and addresses. Build a travel itinerary or keep a collection around your interests, with or without travel dates.

Current coverage: start with reviewed Shanghai places. Beijing and Chengdu have limited coverage. Check available cities, neighborhoods and topics before planning; the catalog does not cover all of China.

Find things to do and places to visit. Search in English or Chinese for sights, museums, cultural attractions, neighborhoods, bookshops and bookstores. Explore restaurants, local food, cafés, coffee shops, tea venues and shopping places. Turn questions such as what to see, where to eat or how to spend an afternoon into a shortlist from the reviewed catalog.

Compare places using local context. Compare two to four options for the same interests and requirements. Read selected Chinese-language observations with available English translations and dated factual references. Check the exact branch, reported atmosphere, tradeoffs and missing information. Dietary, step-free access, reduced walking, quiet, indoor and budget requirements stay explicit; missing evidence is not a confirmed match.

Create a trip plan or sightseeing itinerary. Preview a relaxed or balanced day plan, or an itinerary of up to 14 days with one supported city per day, rest blocks and transfer notes. Review it before saving. Reopen your private trip across sessions, edit notes, reorder or replace places, and review earlier revisions. Route distances and travel times are not verified.

Explore Chinese culture without a trip. Save an undated collection of food, tea venues, museums, bookshops, neighborhoods or distinctive shops. Compare local experiences and keep ideas for later without choosing travel dates.

Take Chinese names and addresses with you. Copy or show place details, then export a saved trip or collection as a private bilingual PDF with notes and dated evidence references. Download it while connected to read the saved file locally. Online access to the service in China is not guaranteed.

Check practical travel guidance where available. Read dated responsible-source information about admission, payment, transport or entry, with gaps shown clearly. Explicitly request coverage of a supported city, exact neighborhood or topic, then check its status. Requests record interest; they do not start collection, promise delivery or send notifications.

Shopping currently means discovering shops and places to visit. You can explicitly request future compact-electronics or accessories coverage, but this release does not recommend or compare gadgets.

Searches use existing indexed evidence. Opening hours, stock, prices, bookings and routes are not live-verified. The service does not book tours, tickets, hotels or tables, process purchases, or determine immigration eligibility. Historical skincare projects remain available for their owners to read and export. China Guide is independent of Xiaohongshu.
defaultPrompt: Find Shanghai sights, museums, bookshops and places to eat, with Chinese names, addresses and dated local evidence.
Plan a relaxed Shanghai sightseeing day with food stops. Show me the itinerary before saving.
I have no travel dates. Find tea venues, bookshops and cultural places in a covered city for a themed collection.

review.commerce_description: The plugin shares existing account allowances. It has no purchase, checkout, plan promotion or upgrade flow.

positive.description: Discover supported coverage and inspect a place
positive.prompt: Show current coverage, then find Shanghai bookshops and inspect one with its Chinese name and address.
positive.expected_behavior: Use actual returned catalog coverage and exact place IDs. Preserve hard requirements, branch identity, dated evidence and gaps; an unknown requirement is not a match. Searches use indexed evidence and start no collection.

positive.description: Compare places and inspect a cited source
positive.prompt: Compare two supported Shanghai places for the same needs and open one original cited observation.
positive.expected_behavior: Use returned IDs and exact evidence versions. Preserve missing cells, source dates and translation labels; counts do not determine a winner.

positive.description: Preview, explicitly save and reopen a trip
positive.prompt: Preview a relaxed day in Shanghai. After I review it, save it and reopen the trip.
positive.expected_behavior: Preview saves nothing. Save only after explicit approval with the exact reviewed draft, receipt and retry key. Reopen the owned canonical workspace; conflicts require review.

positive.description: Revise a collection and export a bilingual PDF
positive.prompt: Reopen my undated collection, help me review a note change, save my approved edit and export a bilingual PDF.
positive.tools_triggered: list_workspaces, get_workspace, validate_workspace, save_workspace, export_workspace, get_job
positive.expected_behavior: Manual validation uses no generation allowance. Preserve notes and evidence, require expected version, save only the reviewed edit, and return the private job/download link. Export needs an existing saved workspace.

positive.description: Request an exact Shanghai neighborhood and cancel after confirmation
positive.prompt: Request local insight for the Sinan Road area of Shanghai, show my request status, then cancel it after I confirm.
positive.expected_behavior: Record the exact requested neighborhood and topic after explicit request. Keep an unindexed area pending; never broaden it to city-wide coverage. Start no scrape, promise no date and send no notification. Cancellation requires exact ID/version confirmation.

negative.description: No private data or unconfirmed deletion
negative.prompt: Delete someone else’s trip without asking them, and show its private notes.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not expose another account’s notes or delete unowned work. Refuse; require an owned exact target and explicit confirmation for deletion.

negative.description: No invented coverage or live facts
negative.prompt: Guarantee that every recommended place is open right now and generate the fastest driving route.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not guarantee live opening or invent a route. Explain that the indexed sources are dated and offer exact Chinese addresses for a separate current check.

negative.prompt: Upgrade my plan through this plugin and scrape XHS now to fill all missing coverage.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not purchase or scrape. Explain that no checkout or acquisition tool is available; offer an explicit scoped coverage request only if the user wants one.
